extracted.message_text: SBI ALERT: Dear SBI Customer, Your State Bank NetBanking and YONO account has been temporarily DEACTIVATED due to pending KYC / PAN verification. To avoid permanent account freeze and blocking of debit card within 24 hours, please update your documents immediately at: http://sbi-kyc-update.top/pan-link. For urgent support, dial officer at: +919876543210 — SBI Automated Security Cell

signals.label: Credential / Identity Document Solicitation
signals.evidence: update your documents immediately at: http://sbi-kyc-update.top/pan-link

signals.label: Threat of Account Suspension within 24 Hours
signals.evidence: avoid permanent account freeze and blocking of debit card within 24 hours

tool_results.detail: Domain registered 2 days ago via privacy proxy. Not an official onlinesbi.sbi or sbi.co.in domain.
Matches known banking credential harvest patterns.

explanation: This message is a dangerous phishing attempt impersonating State Bank of India. Legitimate banks never send links with unofficial domain extensions (.top) or threaten to freeze accounts within 24 hours via SMS.
next_steps: Do NOT click on the link 'http://sbi-kyc-update.top/pan-link'.
Never enter your NetBanking username, password, OTP, or PAN on external websites.
Check your account status safely by logging into the official SBI YONO app or visiting onlinesbi.sbi.
Forward this SMS to 1909 (TRAI DND spam reporting) and report on cybercrime.gov.in.

family_alert.title: 🚨 Urgent: Fake Bank KYC Account Block Scam
family_alert.body: Banks never send SMS links asking you to update KYC or threatening to block your debit card in 24 hours. Never click on links ending in .top or enter your passwords.
tips: Never click links in SMS claiming your bank account is blocked.
Banks never ask for passwords or OTPs over SMS or phone calls.
Only use the official bank app (YONO SBI).

limitations: This assessment is based exclusively on the provided text and imagery. Absence of detected red flags does not guarantee authenticity.
